title: Tattoo Studio Flow - Consult to Aftercare
description: A managed tattoo-studio workflow from consultation to aftercare.
headline: Book the right artist, collect the right brief, protect the session.
subheadline: A focused workflow moves serious inquiries from consultation through design approval, deposit handoff, scheduling, and aftercare.
buyer_signal: Studio managers reconcile DMs, reference images, artist calendars, deposit receipts, and reschedule rules by hand.
outcome: Every booked session arrives with an approved brief and clear owner.
before: Inquiries scatter across social DMs, artists chase missing references, and deposits do not reliably bind to calendar holds.
after: A qualified consult becomes an artist-approved brief, external deposit receipt, confirmed session, and timed aftercare task.

steps.name: Consult
steps.detail: Collect placement, size, style, references, and budget.

steps.name: Design brief
steps.detail: Confirm artist fit and revision boundaries.

steps.name: Deposit
steps.detail: Stage approved terms without making a live charge.

steps.name: Schedule
steps.detail: Reserve the correct artist and session length.

steps.name: Aftercare
steps.detail: Queue healing guidance and check-in tasks.

benefits.title: Protect artist time
benefits.detail: Incomplete or poor-fit inquiries stop before they occupy the calendar.

benefits.title: Bind the handoff
benefits.detail: The schedule waits for an external deposit receipt and approved brief.

benefits.title: Make care consistent
benefits.detail: Each completed session produces the correct aftercare task.

faq.question: Will this auto-approve tattoo designs?
faq.answer: No. The artist approves feasibility, creative direction, and revision boundaries.

faq.question: Does it charge a deposit?
faq.answer: No. The starter includes a disabled pricing preset only; live payments require explicit approval and configuration.

faq.question: Can each artist keep a separate calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. The implementation maps request types to the studio's approved event types and availability rules.

faq.question: Does aftercare replace medical advice?
faq.answer: No. The studio supplies approved guidance and escalation language; the workflow only schedules delivery tasks.
